primary_driver_note: Nominated crude oil realization averaged $50.27/bbl; debt-free standalone balance sheet (₹0 Cr debt, ₹1,85,540 Cr Net Worth) prior to HPCL acquisition.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Standalone ONGC maintained a 100% debt-free balance sheet (₹0 Cr borrowings) with ₹1,85,540 Cr Net Worth and ₹9,510 Cr cash & bank balances prior to the Jan 2018 HPCL acquisition.

primary_driver_note: Crude realization rose 14% to $57.33/bbl; ONGC acquired GoI's 51.11% stake in HPCL for ₹36,915 Cr in Jan 2018 (driving Capex/Investment to ₹72,902 Cr).
balance_sheet_driver_note: Non-Current Financial Investments jumped by ₹36,915 Cr to ₹75,865 Cr and Short-Term Borrowings rose from ₹0 Cr to ₹25,592 Cr to fund the acquisition of GoI's 51.11% equity stake in HPCL in January 2018.

primary_driver_note: Full-year consolidation of HPCL boosted Consolidated Revenue to ₹4.54 Lakh Cr; Standalone revenue jumped 29% on $68.19/bbl crude and record 24.75 BCM gas output.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Equity Share Capital decreased from ₹6,416.63 Cr to ₹6,290.14 Cr following the ₹4,022 Cr share buyback of 25.29 crore shares in Feb 2019; ONGC also repaid ₹3,998 Cr of HPCL bridge debt.

primary_driver_note: PAT declined 49.7% to ₹13,464 Cr due to ₹4,899 Cr Exceptional Impairment in Q4 FY20 when Brent crude crashed below $25/bbl at the onset of COVID-19.
balance_sheet_driver_note: ONGC adopted Ind-AS 116 (Leases) on 1 Apr 2019, recognizing ₹9,300 Cr of Right-of-Use (ROU) Lease Liabilities for charter-hired offshore drilling rigs, FPSOs and OSVs, while reducing Total Borrowings from ₹21,594 Cr to ₹13,949 Cr.

primary_driver_note: Full-year COVID demand shock pushed nominated crude realization down to an 18-year low of $42.78/bbl and APM gas price to $1.96/MMBtu; ₹1,375 Cr impairment reversal cushioned PAT at ₹11,246 Cr.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Despite COVID-19 lows, ONGC funded ₹26,442 Cr Capex (advancing KG-DWN-98/2 CWIP to ₹31,850 Cr) while keeping Total Borrowings contained at ₹15,030 Cr (Debt/Equity of 0.07x).

primary_driver_note: PAT surged 258% to ₹40,306 Cr driven by (1) $76.96/bbl crude rebound, (2) ₹7,178 Cr Exceptional Impairment Reversal, and (3) adoption of Section 115BAA new tax regime (25.17% tax rate) which triggered an ₹8,846 Cr Deferred Tax liability reversal (net tax expense just ₹734 Cr).
balance_sheet_driver_note: Deferred Tax Liabilities (Net) fell by ₹8,846 Cr (from ₹26,677 Cr to ₹17,831 Cr) upon migrating to Section 115BAA, while Standalone Net Worth rose ₹32,586 Cr to ₹2,37,145 Cr and Total Debt was pared down to ₹10,776 Cr.

primary_driver_note: Record Standalone Revenue of ₹1,55,517 Cr on $91.90/bbl gross crude and $7.39/MMBtu gas; GoI introduced SAED Windfall Tax on 1 July 2022, extracting ₹10,964 Cr (pushing Statutory Levies to ₹45,284 Cr), while ₹10,031 Cr exploration dry-well write-offs and HPCL retail fuel losses (Consolidated PAT ₹35,440 Cr) weighed on bottom line.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Surging ₹68,490 Cr Operating Cash Flow allowed ONGC to become Net Cash Positive on a standalone basis (Cash & Bank jumped to ₹21,490 Cr vs Total Debt of ₹7,214 Cr; Net Debt = -₹14,276 Cr) while funding ₹43,890 Cr CWIP.

primary_driver_note: All-time high Standalone PAT of ₹40,526 Cr and Consolidated PAT of ₹57,101 Cr: SAED windfall tax moderated by ₹4,531 Cr, Exploration dry-well write-offs fell by ₹4,463 Cr to ₹5,569 Cr, Other Income rose to ₹10,778 Cr on record subsidiary dividends, and HPCL/MRPL delivered bumper refining margins.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Total Assets crossed ₹4.22 Lakh Cr (`₹4,22,820 Cr`) as first oil from KG-DWN-98/2 Cluster-II transferred CWIP into Oil & Gas Producing Properties (`₹1,41,280 Cr`), while Cash & Bank balances rose to ₹26,840 Cr.

primary_driver_note: Standalone PAT dipped 12.1% to ₹35,610 Cr mainly due to ₹4,257 Cr higher Exploration Dry-Well Write-Offs (₹9,826 Cr vs ₹5,569 Cr) and ₹2,429 Cr higher DD&A as KG-DWN-98/2 Cluster-II ramped up, partially offset by ₹5,830 Cr lower Statutory Levies following SAED windfall tax abolition in Dec 2024.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Investments in Subsidiaries & JVs increased by ₹21,840 Cr to ₹1,14,680 Cr as GoI approved ONGC's ₹18,365 Cr equity conversion in OPaL (raising ONGC's stake to 95.69%) and ONGC Green acquired 1.85 GW of renewable assets.

primary_driver_note: Full-year zero SAED windfall tax saved ₹3,770 Cr in levies (Statutory Levies down to ₹25,999 Cr), while softer Brent crude ($73.40/bbl vs $78.63/bbl) and higher KG-98/2 & offshore workover operating costs tempered Standalone PAT to ₹32,894 Cr; Consolidated PAT rose to ₹49,793 Cr on strong HPCL/OVL earnings.
balance_sheet_driver_note: Standalone Total Assets reached ₹4,74,340 Cr with Net Worth of ₹3,20,635 Cr (Book Value ₹254.87/share), Cash & Bank of ₹21,960 Cr against Total Debt of just ₹7,850 Cr (Net Cash of ₹14,110 Cr; Debt/Equity 0.02x), and Site Restoration Fund corpus of ₹28,950 Cr backing ₹38,450 Cr ARO provision.
